Definition: from G2095 and G3982; good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint:--easy to be intreated.
BiblicalUsage: eupeithḗs means easy to be intreated. In James 3:17, the text says "and] easy to be intreated."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, eupeithḗs, does its job quietly — easy to be intreated — and I leave it at that.
